title: TRACE Registry Anchor Entry
description: One line of a registry/YYYY/MM/DD.ndjson file. Normative format: docs/anchor-format.md section 4.

ts.description: Anchoring time, ISO-8601 UTC with Z suffix

merkle_root.description: RFC 6962 Merkle tree root over the batch, hex-encoded

leaf_count.description: Number of leaves (signed claims) in the batch

producer.description: Identifier of the party that produced and submitted the batch

batch_id.description: Producer-scoped unique identifier for the batch
